incident.title: Emergency Incident Guidance
incident.subtitle: Immediate steps to take if you suspect fraud, sent money, or shared credentials
incident.step1Desc: Call 1930 immediately to freeze fraudulent money transfers within the golden hour.
incident.step2Title: Step 2: File Complaint on National Portal
incident.step2Desc: Submit transaction details, UTR numbers, and screenshots at cybercrime.gov.in.
incident.step3Title: Step 3: Freeze Accounts with Your Bank
incident.step3Desc: Contact your bank's fraud desk to block UPI handles, netbanking, and debit cards.
incident.step4Title: Step 4: Report to SEBI SCORES Portal
incident.step4Desc: For unauthorized investment entities or fake brokers, file a grievance at scores.gov.in.
